info.title: Convoyage API
info.description: REST API for Convoyage. JSON everywhere; /v1 routes take `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`. The convoy WebSocket is described separately in convoy.v1.schema.json.

isNewUser.description: True when this sign-in created the account (prompt for a handle).

wheel.description: Wheel model id from the garage catalogue.

rideHeightMm.description: Offset from stock ride height, millimetres.

body.description: Body style; absent means the default for the kind.

shape.description: Model id from the app's vehicle catalogue (its real proportions), or `generic` for a body picked by hand; absent means match make and model.

staging.description: Where the convoy gathers before the drive.

convoyStops.description: At most 25 [lng, lat] stops for convoy.route; a circuit ends where it starts.

distanceM.description: From the point asked about to where the route starts (staging, else the first waypoint).

character.description: From how much the road turns per kilometre.

kind.description: police, camera, hazard, crash, jam, closure, roadwork, event, flood, fire or alpine.

km.description: Kilometres from the start of the route.

prices.description: Cents per litre by FuelCheck fuel code (U91, E10, P95, P98, DL, PDL, LPG).

offM.description: From the route, metres (route stops only).

cached.description: A saved snapshot, not computed for this request.

canViewContent.description: False for a private account the viewer does not follow: rides, vehicles and posts are hidden.

movingTimeS.description: Seconds spent moving (stops excluded); null if the client did not send it.
Seconds spent moving (stops excluded); null if the client did not send it.

polyline.description: Google encoded polyline of the trace.
Simplified trace, at most about 100 points.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the guest session ends (24 h). There is no refresh token.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; null at the end.

myAction.description: The viewer vote: null when none, never an empty string.

configured.description: False when this server has no PHOTOSCOUT_URL: every other PhotoScout route answers 503.

username.description: The PhotoScout username, when PhotoScout told us at link time.

authorizeUrl.description: Open in a browser or custom tab. It ends at convoyage://photoscout/linked (or ?error=...).

id.description: A community event id, or a crawled event group key.

cruise.description: Set on a community event with a cruise: open its convoy with socket `convoy.cruise {eventId: id}`.

photo.description: Cover photo. The URLs are served by Convoyage and need the bearer token, like /v1/media.

post.summary: Register (or refresh) a push token for this device
post.description: Idempotent. A token already registered to another account moves to this one. At most 10 devices per account (oldest dropped). For `unifiedpush` (builds without Google services) the token is the distributor endpoint (a public https URL) and `p256dh`/`auth` are the app Web Push keys (base64url); notifications are then sent encrypted (RFC 8291) as JSON `{ title, body, data }`.

get.description: Returns the PhotoScout consent URL (OAuth 2 authorization code + PKCE). Open it in a browser or custom tab. When the person has allowed it, PhotoScout redirects to this server's `/v1/photoscout/callback`, which stores the tokens and sends the browser on to `convoyage://photoscout/linked` (or `convoyage://photoscout/linked?error=<code>`). Connecting again replaces the earlier link. Guests cannot link.

404.description: Not found (also used when the viewer may not see the thing)

get.summary: PhotoScout redirects the browser here after consent
get.description: Not called by apps. Exchanges the code, stores the tokens (sealed), and redirects (302) to `convoyage://photoscout/linked`, or `convoyage://photoscout/linked?error=<invalid_state|access_denied|exchange_failed|exchange_rejected|not_configured|...>`. Register `<PUBLIC_BASE_URL>/v1/photoscout/callback` as the redirect URI at PhotoScout.

delete.description: Revokes the connection at PhotoScout (best effort) and deletes the stored tokens. Idempotent.
